_default: No type-specific description is available yet for {type} signatures.

STATIC.description: A file fingerprint checked against its size, partial checksums, and a strong hash.

PEHSTR.description: A PE string signature matches weighted byte or text patterns in a Windows executable.

PEHSTR_EXT.description: An extended PE string signature matches weighted patterns with extended PE-specific metadata.

DEXHSTR_EXT.description: A DEX string signature matches weighted patterns in Android Dalvik executable strings.

AAGGREGATOR.description: An aggregator combines references to other Defender signatures into a detection expression.

AAGGREGATOREX.description: An extended aggregator combines other signature results with a boolean expression.

VERSIONCHECK.description: A version check gates subsequent signature records based on an environment or engine value.

SIGTREE.description: A behavior signature tree represents related nodes, edges, and conditions used to identify behavior.

SIGTREE_EXT.description: An extended behavior signature tree records nodes, edges, and additional conditions.

SIGTREE_BM.description: A behavior-monitoring signature tree describes behavior rules in the BM format.

NID.description: A NID is a numeric reference into Defender's internal name or object table, not a detector.

NID64.description: A NID64 is a 64-bit reference into Defender's internal id table, not a detector.

SNID.description: An SNID references a shared signature record and does not contain the record body itself.

REVOKED_CERTIFICATE.description: A revoked-certificate signature identifies a certificate thumbprint that Defender no longer trusts.
